messages:
mira: ran the usability test on the scopes UI. two quick things: (1) people aren't sure which parts of the app a scope enables, and (2) the red warning toast for broad scopes appears *above* the create CTA and hides it on smaller screens.
rob: thanks — saw that too. users expected scope descriptions inline, not hidden behind a ? tooltip. can we show a short one-line explanation under the scope name with a "learn more" link for details?
toni: +1 for inline copy. also the warning severity needs hierarchy. right now "broad access" and "schedule rotation" share the same red treatment. propose: red only for immediate-danger (delete/rotate-all), amber for broad read/write scopes, and blue/neutral for informational flags.
mira: good call. microcopy: current explanation for "read:all" is "Allows read access" which is vague. suggest: "Read: access to retrieve all workspace secrets (no write). Use for analytics and dashboards only." keep it under 120 chars.
security-bot: policy note: any scope that includes `all` should surface an explicit checkbox: "Allow access to all resources" with an extra confirm step (type org name). also log the granting event.
rob: UX question: where to put the checkbox? inline under the scope with subtle border or in the final confirmation modal? inline makes it more discoverable but adds clutter. thoughts?
toni: inline if it's critical. maybe collapse optional advanced options behind a "Show advanced permissions" toggle. when toggled, show the confirm checkbox for `*` scopes.
mira: accessibility: a11y-bot pointed out that the warning banner currently uses color alone to communicate severity. we need `role=alert` and an icon+text to convey priority, plus `aria-describedby` referencing the scope list so screen readers know which scope triggered it.
a11y-bot: recommended pattern: use `aria-live="assertive"` for immediate-danger banners and ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 on text. Also make the inline scope descriptions focusable for keyboard users (`tabindex=0`) so they can open the tooltip with Enter.
pm-bot: (oops meant pm-bot) pm-bot: please update the acceptance criteria: 1) inline 1-line scope descriptions + learn-more links, 2) visual severity scale (red/amber/blue) with non-color indicators, 3) explicit checkbox/typed confirm for `all` scopes, 4) warning banner placement below CTA on small screens, 5) aria-live/role updates, 6) audit log on grant.
rob: i'll prototype the inline descriptions and adjust warning placement for responsive. mira can you draft the new microcopy variants for read/write/admin?
mira: on it. first pass: "Read: retrieve workspace secrets (safe for reporting)." "Write: create or modify secrets (use sparingly)." "Admin: full management access, rotates & deletes credentials." i'll push three tone variants to the doc.
toni: nice. assign: rob -> prototype and CSS reorder, mira -> microcopy, security-bot -> confirm checkbox rule, a11y-bot -> accessibility checklist. aim for a small canary behind `scoped_grant_v2`.
mira: thanks, acceptance: users understand scope effects at glance, critical warnings require explicit confirmation, banners don't obscure primary CTAs on mobile, and screen readers get assertive notices. :white_check_mark:
